purpose: Position bounded empirical observations; no new algorithm or first-of-kind claim
search_scope: Primary author papers and official numerical/precision documentation
limitation: Targeted primary-source comparison, not a systematic proof that no related report exists

sources.title: npunlock: Write and run custom C kernels for Intel Core Ultra NPUs
sources.venue: Primary software repository and compatibility documentation, 2026
sources.relation: Already exposes custom SHAVE kernels and validated FP32 paths on NPU3720, with explicit graph/precision limits. Neither Intel-NPU programmability nor retained FP32 execution is new here. CATS-NPU uses stock supported graphs and characterizes their exact ranking/output contracts; it does not implement custom SHAVE code or infer its instruction behavior.

sources.authors: Massimiliano Fasi, Nicholas J. Higham, Mantas Mikaitis, Srikara Pranesh
sources.title: Numerical Behavior of NVIDIA Tensor Cores
sources.relation: Established precedent for designed probes of accelerator precision, subnormal handling and undocumented numerical behavior. Our scope is exact selection output contracts and graph composition; characterization itself is not new.

sources.authors: Peichen Xie, Yanjie Gao, Yang Wang, Jilong Xue
sources.title: Revealing Floating-Point Accumulation Orders in Software/Hardware Implementations
sources.relation: FPRev infers accumulation structure through designed numerical probes. CATS-NPU does not recover an instruction sequence or accumulation tree and makes a weaker output-level characterization claim.

sources.title: Orion: Characterizing and Programming Apple's Neural Engine for LLM Training and Inference
sources.relation: NPU compiler/runtime constraint and numerical characterization already exists. Different accelerator and application scope; the present evidence cannot claim to introduce NPU characterization or a general compiler mechanism.

sources.title: onw technical notes
sources.relation: Reports FP16 subnormal-related degradation in Intel NPU inference and conventional scaling mitigations. Broad Intel-NPU subnormal loss is not an exclusive discovery claimed here. This project independently measures exact Top-K membership/value semantics and controlled precision composition.

sources.title: TensorRT Accuracy Considerations
sources.relation: Mixed precision and FP32 execution of sensitive operations are existing mitigation techniques; applying them is not a new optimization.

sources.title: TopK-11 operation specification
sources.relation: Defines stable versus unspecified ties and output values/indices. Used to avoid misclassifying a legal unstable tie as a defect; finite numerical tests do not address implementation-defined NaN ordering.

sources.title: Public high-precision layer option and ConvertPrecisionToFP16 implementation
sources.venue: Pinned upstream source, Phase 12 source audit retained
sources.relation: Existing precision option and operation exemptions explain why this is an ablation of established controls. Source consistency does not establish the installed binary's exact lowering or a unique root cause.

previous_selection_prior_art: docs/FINAL_RESEARCH_CONTRIBUTION.md and results/phase12/fast_track/prior_art_review.json retain the verified CUB, DeepSelect, RadiK, stable selection and hierarchy comparison. The algorithmic NO-GO is unchanged.
defensible_empirical_scope: A reproducible contract-level map of ranking/value failures on one NPU stack, controlled nine-setting composition witnesses, and prospectively frozen correctness-aware latency trade-offs on fresh query IDs.
excluded_claims: first observation of accelerator or Intel NPU subnormal behavior
new Top-K, compiler optimization, mixed precision technique or certificate
universal correctness or a proven instruction-level root cause
